basic_info.description:
Contact via phone to schedule a virtual or in person showing. 628 triple-7 8290.

Large 1250 sqft 2 Bedroom 2 Bathroom unit in a modern yet charming Marina building. Unit features striking dark hardwood floors, plenty of light with two oversized south facing bay windows, and an exceptional location.

The primary bedroom suite has a beautiful custom California Closets walk-in closet and an en-suite bathroom with a large countertop. The guest bedroom comes fitted with a gorgeous custom made California Closets murphy bed that folds in to make space for a kids play area or a home office. Other features include an oversized guest bathroom, in-unit laundry and dryer, video intercom system, gas cooking range, stainless steel appliances, and a large elevator in the building. 

Highly coveted location is only two blocks from the Palace of Fine Arts, two blocks from the Marina waterfront and Marina Green, and a short walk away from Crissy Beach, Presidio, Tennis courts, Baseball diamonds, Basketball hoops and playgrounds. Very close to hundreds of trendy shopping and dining options on Chestnut St. and Union St.

Independent one car parking is available (for extra) and it also includes a private Level 2 EV charging port (32 A). Parking space can fit most mid size SUVs including Tesla Model Y.

Garbage, water, and sewage included. Tenant pays electricity and gas. Only well-qualified tenants with excellent credit score please.

Parking $200/mo.
